name: Agoriva VR Demo
summary:
This is a self-guided showcase of the full Agoriva platform, which is a clinician-designed VR application that brings exposure therapy into everyday care for agoraphobia, panic disorder, and fear of heights. Therapists guide patients through graded, evidence-aligned scenarios that mirror real triggers while keeping sessions safe, repeatable, and on demand.

Scenarios

Included in the demo:
- Airports & Flying: gate, boarding, taxi, take-off, turbulence, landing
- [Coming soon!] Metro: platform, escalators,
